description:
## [1.8.0](https://github.com/WZSE/aapam-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0) (2026-11-25)

### ✨ New Features

* **cred:** stub card tokenization security checks ([1a259cc](https://github.com/WZSE/aapam-patches/commit/1a259cc45f2480a30a7f31d363f62d0507b4be5a))

patches.name: Bundle native ad-strip hook
patches.description: Packages the Prime Video libignite interception library for this APK's ABIs.

patches.name: Clone Prime Video
patches.description: Renames the package to <original>.mod (and its provider authorities / custom permissions) so the patched app installs side-by-side with a non-removable system Prime Video. Opt-in.

patches.name: Disable auto-updates
patches.description: Prevents Google Play Store from automatically replacing the patched APK with the official unpatched version.

patches.name: Load native ad-strip hook
patches.description: Loads libpvhook.so at startup before Prime Video constructs its media pipeline.

patches.name: Override certificate pinning
patches.description: Adds a network_security_config trusting user CAs (no pin sets) so AdGuard Premium can inspect the app's platform-stack HTTPS. Optional adjunct: Prime Video's ad plane is largely native libcurl, so DNS blocking is the primary tool.

patches.name: Prime Video extension
patches.description: Integrates the Prime Video ATV extension for ad group skipping.

patches.name: Skip ads
patches.description: Multi-layer ad suppression targeting the SSAI schedule, impression reporting, and the Volley network chokepoint.

patches.name: Disable Spying & Security Checks
patches.description: Removes other app querying & root checks, for NFC support check the our readme file.

patches.name: Disable CleverTap
patches.description: Prevents the CleverTap analytics SDK from initializing, stopping behavioral tracking and advertising-id (GAID) collection.

patches.name: Disable Firebase analytics
patches.description: Prevents Firebase Analytics from initializing, stopping event and user-property reporting to Google.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes Google IMA ad insertion (client-side and server-side DAI) from the ZEE5 player. The media source factory is returned DRM-configured but with ad-insertion components never attached, so content and DRM playback are unaffected.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Disables all third-party analytics (CleverTap, Firebase, Mixpanel, videoanalytics) by short-circuiting the central analytics dispatch method. No tracking data is sent.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks full Premium VIP status across Monect PC Link TV, enabling 4K/2K/1080p remote desktop streaming, up to 10 hosts, unlimited file transfers, custom screen casting ratios, and removing all ads.

patches.name: Block Flutter Ads
patches.description: Removes home feed advertisements and sponsored community notice cards.

patches.name: Unlock Premium Plan
patches.description: Enables premium resident status and removes promotional banners.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes all AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, app open) by intercepting the Corona SDK AdMob plugin bridge before any ad is initialised, loaded, or shown.

patches.name: Unlock ad-free
patches.description: Hooks CoronaRuntime.onWillLoadMain() to execute a Lua bootstrap script that stubs in-app purchases (Tienda.ProductoComprado returning 'S'), hides promo/ad UI buttons, and stubs libads.

patches.name: Auto skip intro and recap
patches.description: Automatically skips the intro, recap and song segments as soon as the 'Skip' button would appear, without waiting for a tap.

patches.name: Auto-skip Up Next
patches.description: Plays the next episode immediately when the "Up Next" card appears, skipping the auto-play countdown.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables CleverTap, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics, and AppsFlyer tracking and telemetry exfiltration.

patches.name: Disable video ads
patches.description: Disables client-side Google IMA video ads in the SonyLIV player by forcing the ad eligibility check to false and returning an empty ad tag URL.

patches.name: Hide promo banners
patches.description: Hides the CleverTap-driven subscribe/premium promo banners and promo trays on the home screen. Content rows and CleverTap pop-ups/overlays are not affected.

apps.developer: Sony Pictures Networks India Private Limited

patches.name: Disable App Inventory Tracking
patches.description: Prevents INDmoney from querying installed applications, competitor apps, and UPI handlers.

patches.name: Suppress App Blocked Screen
patches.description: Neutralizes Talsec RASP callbacks, threat dispatchers, memory map checks, and AppExitTracker to prevent access blocked screens and premature process termination.

apps.developer: INDmoney: Indian & US Stocks, SIP, Flash Trading

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once and self-destructing media viewable forever; the sender sees them as expired.
